name: drawingset-itemmeta-simple
description: G9 — drawing-set FF&E sheet gains ITEM-META columns. Sets a placed item's ITEM-META (brand + a custom key) via setItemMeta, then captures the printable Drawing set window's HTML (same window.open capture-sink intercept as finish-schedule-simple.json) and asserts the FF&E schedule sheet shows the Brand header + value AND the custom-key header — the same conditional columns the report/CSV already surface, built from the same buildFfeSchedule rows (no separate metadata derivation in drawingSet.ts).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: set-item-meta
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); if (!s.items.length) throw new Error('default layout has no placed items'); const id = s.items[0].id; s.setItemMeta(id, { brand: 'Acme Co', model: 'AC-100', supplier: 'Acme Distribution', url: 'https://www.example.com/products/ac-100?ref=spec', remarks: 'client to purchase', custom: [{ key: 'Warranty', value: '5 years' }] }); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-drawingset-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-drawingset-ffe-meta
steps.eval: (function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; if (!html.includes('FF&E schedule')) throw new Error('Drawing set HTML has no FF&E schedule sheet'); if (!html.includes('Brand')) throw new Error('FF&E sheet is missing the Brand column header'); if (!html.includes('Acme Co')) throw new Error('FF&E sheet is missing the Brand value'); if (!html.includes('Warranty')) throw new Error('FF&E sheet is missing the custom-key (Warranty) column header'); if (!html.includes('5 years')) throw new Error('FF&E sheet is missing the custom-key value'); if (!html.includes('example.com/products/ac-100')) throw new Error('FF&E sheet is missing the shortened URL display'); if (html.includes('ref=spec')) throw new Error('FF&E sheet leaked the full query string — the URL column should be a print-shortened display, not the raw URL'); window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; })()
